what: Comparing Oden and Durant to those drafted in similar positions
title: Worked Example with draftstats
text: player_picks_comps() compares player’s average given measure average median drafted within window picks around , across every draft dataset. compare Oden Durant’s points rebounds per game players picked within three spots . Oden scored 6.7 points average players picked spots 1-4, rebounding right around average. Durant scored 13 points average players picked spots 1-5, 1.5 rebounds.

title: Worked Example with draftstats
text: player_year_comps() compares player two seasons. following example, follow Kevin Durant rookie season (2007-08) 2022-23, 16th active season. Note, data 2019-20 season Durant recovering Achilles injury. Throughout every season, Durant performed better terms points scored rookie season. highest average points per season 2013-14 season, 32 points per game.
code: seasons <- nba_players$season[nba_players$player_name == "Kevin Durant"] seasons <- seasons[-1]  durant <- data.frame()  for (s in seasons) {   stats <- player_year_comps(nba_players, "Kevin Durant", "2007-08", s, "pts")   durant <- rbind(durant, stats) }  durant$Season <- seasons durant #>          Player Draft_Year             Seasons Measure Season1_value #> 1  Kevin Durant       2007 text: draftstats tool analyze whether NBA WNBA player’s draft position reflective performance throughout career league. package allows one summarize compare player performance across different draft-pick ranges, compare player others drafted near , compare player across different seasons, using real data NBA WNBA. Documentation: https://b-rubinstein.github.io/draftstats/

title: Analyzing NBA and WNBA Career Performance Relative to Draft Position
Analyzing NBA and WNBA Career Performance Relative to Draft Position
text: nba_players dataset adapted Kaggle containing player information 1996-97 2022-23 NBA seasons. includes draft rankings, personal details, NBA box-score statistics. 12,844 player rows, one row per player season. nba_draft dataset adapted Kaggle containing NBA draft data 1989 2021. 1,922 rows one row per player career per-game statistics. wnba_draft dataset adapted Kaggle containing WNBA draft data 1997 2022. 1,064 rows one row per player career per-game statistics.

title: Analyzing NBA and WNBA Career Performance Relative to Draft Position
text: draft_rank_stats() function takes four items: dataset, minimum number maximum number (representing draft picks), metric. function calculate average median value chosen performance metric players within specified range. draft_rank_comps() function takes dataset, two ranges, performance metric. compares average median values two different draft pick ranges, calling draft_rank_stats(), returns difference . player_picks_comps() function takes dataset, player’s name, performance metric, optional window (default = 5). compare player’s statistic average picked within given window. player_year_comps() function takes dataset similar style nba_players, player’s name, two seasons, measure. function compare player’s performance two given seasons.

title: Analyzing NBA and WNBA Career Performance Relative to Draft Position
text: nba_players, nba_draft, wnba_draft datasets included package, calling library(draftstats) sufficient. Example function uses:
code: # Average and median points for picks 1-10  draft_rank_stats(nba_players, min_pick = 1, max_pick = 10, measure = "pts")  # Compare picks 1-10 and 11-20 average and median points draft_rank_comps(nba_players, 1, 10, 11, 20, measure = "pts")  # Compare Michael Jordan's average points to players drafted within three picks of him player_picks_comps(nba_players, "Michael Jordan", "pts", 3)  # Compare Jalen Brunson's average points from the 2019-20 season to the 2021-22 season player_year_comps(nba_players, "Jalen Brunson", "2019-20", "2021-22", "pts")
